tieu_de: Giai quyet mau thuan NFR-P1: do lai E2E CLIENT-SIDE qua HTTP tren best.pt
muc_dich: Con so cu 5857,19 ms (bao cao Phase 7) va con so moi 780,36 ms (in-process, T5.7a) chenh 7,5 lan. Phep do nay xac dinh con so nao la con so E2E that su cho NFR-P1 bang cach do CLIENT-SIDE qua HTTP tren dung mo hinh chinh thuc best.pt, cung phuong phap voi bao cao cu (warmup truoc, bo cold-start, roi do >=50 anh that).

cau_hinh_do.tai_nen_khi_do: May RANH (CPU idle ~5%, KHONG co tien trinh huan luyen chay song song). Day la diem khac biet then chot so voi phep do cu.

cold_start_wall_ms.ghi_chu: Cold-start THAP vi pipeline da duoc warmup ngay khi khoi dong server (lifespan warmup 2,54 s). 10 request dau khong bi phat cold-start. Ket luan: co warmup luc khoi dong thi khong con vung cold-start trong duong E2E.

warm_server_processing_ms.ghi_chu: Thoi gian pipeline bao cao trong response processing_time (chi suy luan, khong tinh mang).

warm_api_transport_overhead_ms.ghi_chu: Chenh giua wall client va processing server = mang + tuan tu hoa. Phu hop NFR-P5 (overhead API muc tieu <=50 ms).

ket_luan.con_so_cong_bo_nfr_p1: 731,15 ms (client-side warm p95, best.pt, qua HTTP).
ket_luan.trang_thai_nfr_p1: DAT muc tieu 800 ms (du 68,85 ms) va thoa man ca nguong toi thieu 1500 ms.
ket_luan.vi_sao_dong_thuan: Con so client-side (731 ms) va con so in-process (780 ms) chi chenh ~6-7%, nam trong sai so lay mau CPU. Ca hai deu KHANG DINH E2E that su khoang 700-780 ms, KHONG phai 5857 ms. Con so 780 ms in-process KHONG gay hieu nham: khi do lai qua HTTP that su tren may ranh, wall-clock client con thap hon (731 ms) vi phep do in-process T5.7a nham dung tap 100 anh khac va chiu bien dong tai CPU luc do.
vi_sao_con_so_cu_5857_sai: 1. NHIEM DO TAI CANH TRANH (nguyen nhan chinh): file 07-benchmark-data.json cua chinh phep do cu ghi ro competing_processes co 'python -m ai.training.train ... cpu=793%' — mot tien trinh huan luyen dang an het CPU trong luc do. Bao cao cu tu no da tinh lai tren 80 mau dau (vung it nhiem) ra p95 ~3283 ms va ghi 'p95=5857 roi dung vao vung bi nhiem'. Do lai tren may RANH: p95 chi con 731 ms.
2. SAI MO HINH: 5857 ms do tren checkpoints/best-cpu-epoch7.pt — checkpoint giua chung, KHONG phai best.pt chinh thuc.

3. LOI CROP + OCR doc rong o epoch7: crop qua lon khien PaddleOCR chay ca khoi text-detection tren anh lon, day ocr len ~1322 ms/anh va lam ty trong OCR phong len 93,3% (xem muc sua breakdown ben duoi). Sau khi sua, ocr chi con ~112,55 ms/bien.

GIA THUYET oneDNN/cold-start: KHONG phai nguyen nhan. Server chay voi enable_mkldnn=false (oneDNN da tat) va cold-start do duoc chi 176 ms p95 vi pipeline warmup ngay luc khoi dong. Nguyen nhan that la (1)+(2)+(3).
ket_luan.gia_thuyet_baseline_cham: BAC BO. baseline-416-v1 do client-side ra 763,75 ms p95, gan nhu y het best.pt (731 ms). Su khac biet 7,5 lan cua con so cu KHONG den tu mo hinh.

sua_breakdown_ty_trong_buoc.con_so_cu_sai: PaddleOCR chiem 93,3% do tre / detect 6,5% (bao cao Phase 7, muc 4).

con_so_dung_tren_best_pt.nguon: 05-results.json -> T5.7b (do that tren best.pt, 40 mau, 1,57 bien/anh)

sua_breakdown_ty_trong_buoc.giai_thich: Con so 93,3% do mot he thong dang co loi crop (OCR doc anh crop qua lon = 1322 ms/anh). Tren best.pt da sua, OCR chi con ~112,55 ms/bien = 64,3% tong, detect 59,83 ms = 34,2%. OCR VAN la buoc ton kem nhat nhung KHONG con ap dao — toi uu bo phat hien (34,2%) gio da co y nghia thuc su, khac voi ket luan cu.

tep_nguon_va_bang_chung.con_so_cu: docs/reports/07-benchmark-data.json -> system_performance.nfr_p1_e2e_latency (5857,19 ms) + competing_processes (bang chung nhiem tai)
